steps.clue: Complete the four character rituals and collect their Gateworms.
Obtain and upgrade the Apothicon Swords.
Defend the flag at two locations in each district, then return it to all four ritual altars.
Give the Keepers the upgraded swords to break the Shadowman’s shield.
Force the Shadowman over the altar and trap him with the Summoning Key.
Electrify the three tram rails, hit the Gateworm with the tram, then shock the three Keepers.
